description: This class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for creating a passenger, including fields for phone, email, name, date of birth, and last four digits of Aadhaar, with validation annotations.

classes.name: PassengerCreateRequest
classes.description: DTO class for passenger creation request, with validation rules for each field.
